policies.selection: maximum paired development mean realized utility; canonical first-index tie break
policies.parameter_budget_caveat: fixed_cross7 matches count but allocates extra capacity to physical drift; fixed_shared6 is the pure structural comparison
policies.ordinary_threshold_information: Same full public observation; a learned constant distance repair threshold with common native negative-continuation STOP guard. Price and deadline do not explicitly parameterize this repair gate.
policies.first_event_interpretation: Cost/time-sensitive value boundary with only the first failure; retained as a stronger renewal ablation.

statistics.unit: model seed then paired whole episode
statistics.pass_rule: family-adjusted empirical lower bound > .005 and all seed means positive
statistics.interval_rule: Two-sided Bonferroni: alpha/(2*3) in each tail; all previous comparisons retained.

stress.interpretation: descriptive prespecified model mismatch; not population robustness certification

validation.kernel_reference: independent quadrature plus derivatives and killed mass/composition
validation.runtime: multiple events, leftover time, refractoriness, checkpoint replay, identity mismatch
validation.training: all six common parameter groups active and actual optimizer/parameter deltas retained
validation.native: exact source and binary bound; independent finite-tree/path arithmetic; V2 candidate identities
validation.quantization: Q32 rounding error separate from distribution/model/plan error

amendment.reason: Independent review identified first-event comparator as a value-boundary renewal ablation, not an ordinary trainable threshold. Add an ordinary threshold family; retain previous primary comparisons and strengthen multiplicity adjustment.
